court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

opinions.text: Motion for leave, to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

attorneys: Petitioner pro se. James W. Kynes, Attorney General of Florida, and George R. Georgieff, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.
